headline: IT Project Manager
summary: IT project manager with eleven years delivering software and infrastructure projects for banks, cooperatives and the public sector. I run agile and PRINCE2 projects, manage budgets of up to ₱60 million, and lead cross-functional teams of up to twenty people. I am known for honest status reporting and for getting vendors and users to agree on scope.
highlights: Delivered a core banking migration for 32 cooperative branches with no unplanned downtime.
Introduced Scrum and Jira across five delivery teams; forecast accuracy on releases rose from about 50% to 85%.
Renegotiated a vendor contract mid-project, saving ₱7 million without cutting scope.
skills: Project planning, budgeting and risk management

experience.title: IT Project Manager
bullets: Lead a portfolio of four to six IT projects at a time for member cooperatives across Northern Luzon.
Manage a team of 14 developers, testers and analysts, including hiring and performance reviews.
Run steering committees and monthly budget reviews with cooperative boards.

experience.title: Project Lead
bullets: Led the rollout of document tracking systems for three provincial government offices.
Coordinated developers, trainers and client focal persons across multiple sites.

experience.title: Systems Analyst
bullets: Gathered requirements and wrote specifications for the company's first government project.
Prepared test scripts and user manuals for the pilot office.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
